title: Stored XSS in report date selection
vulnerabilityInformation: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was discovered in the date-selection controls of standard reports. A crafted period preset value could be saved in a user's session and inserted into JavaScript without proper encoding, allowing malicious code to execute during report views. The vulnerability was resolved by implementing JSON encoding for date-selection values in their JavaScript context, with the same encoding applied to audit date-selection fields.
